battle.name: 洛口倉之戰
battle.brief: 隋煬帝大業十三年二月，瓦崗軍首領翟讓、李密率精兵七千人出陽城，越過方山、從羅口直抵洛口倉，一舉奪下隋朝最大的儲糧樞紐。守軍退保倉城，瓦崗軍開倉濟貧，饑民背糧數十里相接，軍勢遂盛，洛陽糧道為之中斷。卡面秦連弩屬守城弩機一類，於倉城攻守正得其用。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 洛口倉之戰是隋大業十三年（617）二月瓦崗軍與隋朝在河南鞏縣洛口倉的一場爭奪戰役，交戰重心不是城池，而是隋朝最大的國家糧倉。瓦崗軍一方以翟讓、李密為首，起於瓦崗寨的部眾經數年吞併魯郡、萊州及河南郡縣的歸附義軍後膨脹為數十萬眾，作戰核心是李密直屬的精騎與步卒混編部隊，糧秣則仰給於所奪州縣與最後攻下的洛口倉。指揮上翟讓為元首、李密主謀略，設行軍總管、內樞密等職分掌兵權與糧道調度。隋一方則是東都洛陽的留守體系：幼主越王楊侗在位，段達、元文都、王世充等將佐各掌一節，守備與糧餉調度互不統一，京師宿衛與外州郡兵分屬不同系統，主力尚有韋雲起所領的精兵可以抽調。最高樞紐在江都的隋煬帝處，詔令由數千里外傳至洛陽，援軍需先抵都城再往東出，遲緩而難以齊一。整場戰役的勝負，實是隋廷在中原的儲糧樞紐與瓦崗軍的生存線兩條線的對撞。
countriesEn: The Battle of Luokou Granary was fought in the second month of the thirteenth year of the Daye era (February 617) between the Wagang army and the Sui dynasty over the great state granary at Luokou, in Gong County, Henan. The stake was not a walled city but the Sui state's largest storehouse. On the Wagang side the host was led by Zhai Rang and Li Mi; the bands that had started at Wanggangzhai had spent years absorbing the rebel forces of Lu, Lai and the loyalist contingents of the Henan commanderies, and had swollen into a host numbering in the tens of thousands. Its fighting core was Li Mi's own mixed column of elite cavalry and foot, while its grain came from the counties it had seized and, at the last, from Luokou itself. Command was split between Zhai Rang as the acknowledged head of the host and Li Mi as the strategist; offices such as xingjun zongguan and neizhuemi were created to divide the handling of troops and of the supply line. The Sui side was the garrison establishment of the eastern capital, Luoyang: the child ruler Prince of Yue, Yang Tong, sat nominally at the top, while generals such as Duan Da, Yuan Wendu and Wang Shichong each held one piece of the command, with the defence works and the grain issue worked separately and unreconciled; the palace guard of the capital and the troops of the outer commanderies belonged to different systems, though the Sui still had picked columns such as the one led by Wei Yunqi to draw on. The supreme authority lay with Emperor Yang at Jiangdu, so the edicts travelled thousands of li before reaching Luoyang, and any relief column had to come to the capital first and only then move east, slow and impossible to bring to a single plan. The whole contest was in truth the collision of two lines: the Sui court's storehouse pivot in the Central Plain against the Wagang army's line of survival.
people: 瓦崗軍首領翟讓是長年在瓦崗寨聚眾的豪帥，起事最早、眾望所歸，但治軍與謀略略遜；李密出身遼東名門，曾任隋朝西京留守屬官，大業十三年投奔瓦崗後以計略見長，很快取得實權，他主張分兵掠地、據倉為本，洛口倉之役正是他先取糧而後圖城的主張落實。偵察洛陽城內虛實的是李密所遣的親信裴方俗，此舉被留守官員察覺，遂加強守備並急報江都的隋煬帝；瓦崗軍中主張乘虛攻東都、並統率七千精兵出陽城、越方山、從羅口直取洛口倉的，也正是李密。隋軍方面，領兵救援洛口倉的大將韋雲起是隋室宿將，兵敗後收攏殘部退保河陽；留在洛陽的段達、元文都、王世充則勉力支撐城防，終究未能阻止洛陽被瓦崗軍長期圍困。瓦崗軍將領裡，以房彥藻出戰迎擊隋援最為著稱；裴行儉於此役中為流矢所中，眇一目，軍中呼為「裴瞎子」，其後仍隨李密轉戰各地，於唐時官至兵部尚書。
peopleEn: Zhai Rang, the chief of the Wagang host, was a local notable who had long gathered followers at Wanggangzhai. He had risen first and held the loyalty of the host, though he was the weaker of the two in command and in planning. Li Mi came of a distinguished family in Liaodong and had served as an officer under the Sui Western Capital garrison; when he joined the Wagang band in the thirteenth year of Daye his talent for strategy gave him real power very quickly. He argued for spreading out to seize districts and making the granary the base of operations, and the battle for Luokou was precisely his principle of taking the grain first and the city afterwards made concrete. The man sent to scout the state of affairs inside Luoyang was Li Mi's own confidant Pei Fangsú; the garrison officials detected him, tightened the defences and reported the matter in haste to Emperor Yang at Jiangdu. It was Li Mi too who pressed for an attack on the eastern capital while the enemy was hollow and who led the seven thousand picked men out of Yangcheng, over Fangshan and in by Luokou. On the Sui side Wei Yunqi, a veteran of the Sui house, was sent with the relief column; after his defeat he gathered the remnants and fell back to Heyang. In Luoyang, Duan Da, Yuan Wendu and Wang Shichong laboured to hold the city and in the end could not prevent it from being invested for a long time by the Wagang host. Among the Wagang commanders, Fang Yanzao is the best remembered for meeting the Sui relief in the field; Pei Xingjian was struck by a stray arrow in this campaign and lost the sight of one eye, so the host called him Blind Pei, and he went on to fight with Li Mi and in Tang times rose to be Minister of War.
kits: 卡面兵器秦連弩屬中國弩機一路，其法以弩機蓄力、腳踏上弦，一發既畢即踩再發，單兵可連射而不必反覆上弦，是守城器械中最能壓制城外進攻者的裝備之一。漢末諸葛亮曾集弩機之術，東漢馬援亦奏請造連弩用於南征，可見此物在隋唐之際已非絕響；洛口倉之役的史冊雖未逐件點名器械，但倉城四面必有弓弩覆壓，瓦崗軍突入之後亦必以弩手封住城門缺口、壓制向外潰散之卒，卡面之器正屬此役攻防兩端都可能出現的兵種。除連弩之外，隋軍尚備擲車、撞車、雲梯、拒馬一類攻城與守城之具，騎兵、步卒與運糧的車牛同編，糧道自洛水與陸路並行；瓦崗軍出動僅用精兵七千人，人少而銳，全靠突行與開倉後徵發的民夫背糧維持糧秣。洛口倉本身也是一件巨大的裝備：二十餘座圓形糧窖連成一片，即隋唐糧儲制度的實物；爭的是它，便等於奪了半個河南的食糧。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card, the Qin repeating crossbow, belongs to the Chinese crossbow-trigger line of ordnance. Its method is to store the draw in the trigger housing and step on the stirrup to reload: once a bolt is loosed the next is cocked by pressure of the foot, so a single man can shoot continuously without stringing the bow again. Among siege defences it is one of the instruments best able to pin down an attacker outside the wall. Zhuge Liang of the late Han gathered together the arts of the repeating trigger, and in the Eastern Han Ma Yuan petitioned to build repeating crossbows for his southern campaigns, so the device was by no means extinct in the Sui and Tang. Although the records of the battle at Luokou do not itemise the ordnance, the four sides of the storehouse city must certainly have been covered by bows and crossbows, and once the Wagang troops had forced their way in they must have used crossbowmen to seal the gaps in the gates and to pin down the men breaking out towards the open country; the weapon on the card is of exactly the kind that could stand on either side of this contest. Besides the repeating crossbow, the Sui force still carried such siege and defence apparatus as the hurling cart, the ram, the scaling ladder and the cheval-de-frise, with cavalry, foot and draught oxen mixed into the same columns, and the supply line running by the Luo river and by road at once. The Wagang army moved with only seven thousand picked men: few but sharp, sustained entirely by the surprise movement and by the civilian porters who carried the grain out once the storehouse was opened. Luokou itself was also a vast piece of equipment, a spread of more than twenty round granary pits, the physical form of the Sui and Tang grain-storage system. To fight for it was to fight for half of Henan's food.
tactics: 瓦崗軍的戰法，是一套先取節點、再圖都城的經濟與軍事合一策略。二月，翟讓、李密不帶大軍，只以精兵七千人出陽城，越過方山，從羅口（今鞏縣東南）直撲洛口倉，全程避開洛陽城的正面城防，不與守軍在堅城之下耗時間，趕在隋朝援軍抵達之前把糧倉奪到手。得手之後，軍隊不急於分糧入軍，而是開倉濟貧：饑民任意取糧，老人孺子亦盡力背負，數十里道路上人貨相接，一夕之間把瓦崗軍的旗號送到洛陽四面的窮鄉。隋方的應對則顯得遲緩：先由留守官員加強城防，繼而遣精兵往救；救援之師抵近倉城時，瓦崗軍以精騎迎擊，隋軍大敗，韋雲起收殘兵退保河陽，倉城內守軍糧盡而援不至，終以突圍奔洛陽收場。隨後李密乘勝進逼洛陽，據記載隋將段達據城出戰，一度擊退瓦崗前鋒，但已無力補上糧道上的缺口。
tacticsEn: The Wagang method was a single strategy joining economics to warfare: take the node first, take the capital afterwards. In the second month, Zhai Rang and Li Mi marched without a mass army, taking only seven thousand picked men out of Yangcheng, over Fangshan and straight at Luokou by the road from Luokou in the south-east of present Gong County. The movement avoided the frontal defences of Luoyang entirely and refused to spend time under a strong city wall, and it was aimed at putting hands on the granary before the Sui relief could arrive. Having won it, the troops did not hurry to divide the grain into the army; they opened the storehouse and fed the starving, letting the hungry take what they would, with old men and children carrying loads on their backs and people and goods strung out along tens of li of road, so that within a single night the Wagang banner was carried to the poor villages around Luoyang. The Sui response was noticeably slow: the garrison officers first strengthened the defences of the city, and only then were picked troops sent to the rescue. When the relief column drew near the storehouse city the Wagang met it with elite cavalry, and the Sui army was badly beaten; Wei Yunqi gathered the remnants and withdrew to Heyang, while the troops inside the storehouse, their grain exhausted and no relief coming, at last broke out and ran for Luoyang. Li Mi then pressed the advantage and closed on Luoyang; the record says the Sui general Duan Da fought out from the city and at one point drove back the Wagang vanguard, but nothing could be done to repair the gap in the supply line.
data: 可考的數字並不多，但大致能勾勒戰役的規模與節奏。時間在大業十三年（617）二月，舊曆二月約當公曆三月初。奇襲兵力為精兵七千人，行動路線是出陽城（今河南登封東南）、越方山、由羅口（今鞏縣東南）直抵洛口倉，騎行一日可達。洛口倉在洛水北岸、鞏縣城東北，考古發掘可見二十餘座圓形糧窖，窖口直徑約八米上下，深約七至八米，單窖可容數百噸糧食，隋人稱其積貯足以支用數十年。隋軍救援一役的斬獲，舊史概以萬餘級計，數目未必可確考，但可斷定遠超過一次尋常的遭遇戰。圍倉歷時數月，韋雲起糧盡突圍，追兵追至洛陽外為隋軍所邀而還。與此同時，洛陽附從瓦崗軍者日以千數，糧道一斷，城內物價與人心隨之改變。
dataEn: Not many hard numbers survive, but enough to sketch the scale and the rhythm of the campaign. The date is the second month of the thirteenth year of Daye (February 617), which by the Gregorian reckoning falls around the beginning of March. The striking force was seven thousand picked men, and the route ran out of Yangcheng, in the south-east of present Dengfeng, Henan, over Fangshan and in from Luokou in the south-east of present Gong County to the granary itself, a day’s ride. Luokou stood on the north bank of the Luo river, north-east of the county seat of Gong; excavation has brought to light more than twenty round granary pits, with mouths of roughly eight metres across and seven to eight metres deep, each able to hold several hundred tonnes of grain, and the Sui called the accumulated stores sufficient to feed the realm for tens of years. The Sui relief column is credited in the old histories with casualties of rather more than ten thousand heads; the figure cannot be taken as exact, but it is certain the battle was far heavier than a routine skirmish. The investment of the storehouse ran for several months. Wei Yunqi, his grain gone, broke out; the pursuing Wagang troops were intercepted by Sui troops outside Luoyang and turned back. At the same time the number of people in Luoyang who went over to the Wagang was counted in hundreds each day, and once the supply line was cut the prices inside the city and the mood of the people changed with it.
cause: 打起來的原因，是隋末中原的糧政崩壞與人口流亡逼出來的。隋煬帝連年征高句麗，役繁而民疲，洛陽四郊良田拋荒，倉廒雖大，裝的卻多是從各地強徵來的粟米，地方上有粟不能食的矛盾尖銳異常。翟讓自梁郡起事以來，瓦崗寨部眾在饑民之中不斷擴張；大業十三年李密西來投之，憑其世家子弟與文吏背景，很快聚起數萬眾，並先後收下洛陽四周郡縣的歸附，聲勢直逼東都城下。李密據偵察所得，判斷洛陽守軍缺乏訓練、越王楊侗幼弱無知、段達與元文都等將佐明哲無謀且彼此不統，隋煬帝又遠在江都、詔令來遲，於是提出乘虛攻東都；同時分兵兩路，一取洛口倉以斷糧，一窺洛陽城內虛實。這是一場以糧食為爭奪物、以民心為替代品的戰爭。
causeEn: The reason the fighting started was forced on the Central Plain by the collapse of the Sui grain administration and by a people turned adrift. Emperor Yang had campaigned against Goguryeo year upon year, the corvées were heavy and the people worn out, the good fields around Luoyang lay fallow, and the granaries, large as they were, were filled mostly with grain squeezed out of the provinces, so that the contradiction of grain in the storehouses and none in the belly of the people grew sharp. Since Zhai Rang first rose at Liangjun the Wanggangzhai bands had swollen among the hungry; when Li Mi came west and joined them in the thirteenth year of Daye, his standing as a scion of a great family and his training as a clerk let him muster tens of thousands quickly, and one after another the commanderies around Luoyang came over to him, bringing his host right up to the walls of the eastern capital. On the strength of his scouting Li Mi judged that the Luoyang garrison was untrained, that the boy-prince Yang Tong was too young to rule, that generals such as Duan Da and Yuan Wendu were neither able nor united, and that Emperor Yang sat far away at Jiangdu with his orders slow in coming. He therefore proposed striking the eastern capital while it was hollow, and split his force into two: one to take Luokou and cut the grain, one to look over the inside of the city. It was a war fought for grain as the prize and for the hearts of the people as the substitute.
impact: 洛口倉落入瓦崗軍之手，影響大到改變了隋末中原的權力版圖。糧道一斷，東都洛陽從此只能靠東都餘糧與四方接濟勉強支撐，隋廷在中原的統治至此名存實亡。李密開倉散粟，饑民負糧相接，響應入伍與輸糧者數以萬計，瓦崗軍由一股流寇變成有糧、有地、有眾的割據力量，隨後又取黎陽、虎牢一帶，進窺洛陽。這場勝利也把隋廷最後的掙扎逼到失控：大業十三年底宇文化及在江都弒煬帝，立句踐帝，隋朝名號隨之崩解；越王侗在洛陽即位，王世充很快自稱帝位，於是洛陽一隅再易其主，瓦崗軍反成了這一連串變局中的變數與受害方，兩線受敵之下終於在武德元年（618）為宇文化及所破，李密西降唐朝。洛口倉的物資後來成為唐軍在河南的糧源，倉址歷代沿用為官倉，今日所存二十四座糧窖遺址，已是這場戰爭留下的最硬證據。
impactEn: Luokou falling to the Wagang host changed the map of power in the late Sui Central Plain outright. With the supply line cut, the eastern capital could thereafter live only on what grain remained in the city and on help from the four quarters, and Sui rule in the Central Plain was a name and nothing more. Li Mi opened the storehouse and scattered the grain; the starving carried loads away shoulder to shoulder, and tens of thousands came to enrol or to bring in grain, so the Wagang host turned from a band of refugees into a power with grain, with territory and with a following. It went on to take Lingyang and Hulao and to press against Luoyang. The victory also pushed the last spasms of the Sui court out of control: at the end of the thirteenth year of Daye, Yuwen Huaji murdered the emperor at Jiangdu and set up a puppet in the person of a grandson, and the Sui name itself collapsed with him. Yang Tong was enthroned at Luoyang, and Wang Shichong soon proclaimed himself emperor, so that Luoyang changed hands again; the Wagang host, now the variable and the victim in this chain of events, was pressed from two sides and finally broken by Yuwen Huaji in the first year of Wude (618), after which Li Mi surrendered to Tang in the west. The stores of Luokou later became a grain source for the Tang armies in Henan; the site was kept in use as an official granary through successive dynasties, and the twenty-four granary pits that survive today are the hardest physical evidence left by this war.
result: 結果是瓦崗軍完勝，隋軍完敗。精兵七千自陽城出、越方山、從羅口入，一舉奪下洛口倉；倉內守軍退保倉城，後因糧盡而由韋雲起率殘部突圍奔洛陽，追兵追至洛陽城外被隋軍邀擊退回。洛口倉連同其積貯數十年之糧盡歸李密，開倉濟貧，饑民負糧數十里相接，瓦崗軍由此占領洛陽外圍的戰略要地，取得主動，隋朝在東都的糧食供應被從根上切斷，洛陽自此陷入長期圍困。惟須留意，這場勝利並非終局：倉糧再多，也養不起一次漫長圍城的消耗與內部的不和，李密與翟讓之間、與部將之間的爭功與裂痕同時加深，兩年之後瓦崗軍在洛陽與虎牢一線為宇文化及所破，李密降唐，洛口倉隨之易主。洛口倉之戰因此是隋亡前夜最典型的一場糧倉爭奪戰：以七千精兵換一座空城，用糧食換取了中原的民心。
resultEn: The result was a complete Wagang victory and a complete Sui defeat. Seven thousand picked men marched out of Yangcheng, over Fangshan and in from Luokou and seized the granary at a stroke. The defenders within fell back into the storehouse city, and later, their grain exhausted, broke out under Wei Yunqi and ran for Luoyang, the pursuers driven back by the Sui when they reached the outskirts of the city. Luokou, with the grain stored in it for tens of years, passed wholly into Li Mi's hands. The storehouses were opened and the starving fed; men carried loads of grain along tens of li of road, one behind another. The Wagang host thus took the strategic ground around Luoyang and gained the initiative, the Sui supply for the eastern capital was cut at the root, and Luoyang fell into a long investment. It should be noted, however, that this victory was no final settlement. However much grain the warehouse held, it could not feed the cost of a long siege together with the dissension inside the host; the quarrels over credit between Li Mi and Zhai Rang, and between Li Mi and his generals, deepened at the same time. Two years later the Wagang host was broken near Luoyang and Hulao by Yuwen Huaji, Li Mi surrendered to Tang, and Luokou changed hands with him. The battle for Luokou therefore stands as the most typical granary war of the eve of Sui's end: seven thousand picked men traded for an empty city, and grain traded for the hearts of the Central Plain.
